abs: This article has been based entirely on published reports, and the writer has asked me to make and appeal to our American readers, to which I gladly assent, that they might not only furnish the Journal with material to correct errors and supply omissions in an article which the writer feels may be based on possibly incomplete information, but also to submit a view of the recent changes in the American Civil Service at home and abroad, from a closer angle than that of an observer at a distance.‐Editor.
